ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=47b7d39a4628 (2026-05-13T10:59:26Z) modified recommendation-service/internal/cache/model_cache.go and recommendation-service/config/cache_config.yaml, inadvertently setting max_entries=unlimited and eviction_policy=none in the ML model cache. Concurrently, the feature store migrated embedding vectors from 512-dim (2048 bytes) to 1536-dim (6144 bytes) per vector (3x size increase). With no eviction policy and 3x larger embeddings being cached on every cache miss, heap consumption grows unbounded, exhausting the 8GB pod memory limit within ~8 minutes of startup and causing repeated OOMKills.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately restart the recommendation-service pod to restore temporary service, then apply a config hotfix to recommendation-service/config/cache_config.yaml setting max_entries=50000 and eviction_policy=lru before the next restart to prevent immediate re-OOM. 2. In model_cache.go, restore the prior cache configuration defaults (max_entries=50000, eviction_policy=lru) that were overwritten in sha=47b7d39a4628, and update the expected embedding byte size from 2048 to 6144 to match the feature store v4.2 schema. 3. Deploy the fix, verify heap stabilizes below 4GB under normal load, and reopen the api-gateway circuit breaker once p99 latency returns below 500ms.
